irst look at the OneXPlayer Super X powered by the Ryzen AI Max+ 395—with a stunning 14" 120Hz AMOLED display and VRR.
Benchmarks, real game testing, and early battery estimates—plus how it stacks up to the ROG Flow Z13.

Learn More Here: https://onexplayerstore.com/products/onexplayer-super-x?srsltid=AfmBOorwvGeWeGntlBwe0Lb03kyIYAsr7lcBpgL3L4z5Hsv2l2HrklLP&variant=51886879998246

In this video I’m taking a first look at the all-new OneXPlayer Super X, a premium 2-in-1 gaming tablet that’s already getting compared to the ASUS ROG Flow Z13—but the Super X brings a major advantage: a 14-inch 120Hz AMOLED panel with HDR and VRR (48–120Hz) at 2880×1800 (16:10). Under the hood it’s running AMD’s Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (16C/32T) with up to 128GB of fast unified memory, Wi-Fi 7, and an 85.58Wh battery.
